FTC Ultimate Goal Robot

FTC Freight Frenzy Robot

  • Trailing-arm suspension mecanum wheel drivetrain.
  • Custom carbon-fiber Virtual-4-Bar mechanism.
  • Won 2 regional tournaments and was a state championship finalist. Ranked 3rd in the Chesapeake District (VA/MD/DC/WV) and invited to the international championship.

FTC Power Play Robot

  • 5.5 ft vertical extension designed for placing plastic cones.
  • 3 ft horizontal extension for extra reach on cones.
  • Won awards at the state and regional competitions.
  • 3D-printing, PTC Onshape CAD, Fusion 360 rendering, CNC machining, wiring and cable management.

Applied Impact Robotics: CoreXY Gantry

  • R&D and technical engineering projects, including a CoreXY pool gantry that assists robot localization while submerged in a simulated crude oil environment.
  • Prototyped ideas for robot oil rig entry and submersion without internal flooding or pressure implosion.
  • Simulated and tested 3D-printed rotor fins to find high-performing models for high-viscosity fluids such as oil.

Purdue Undergraduate Rocket Propulsion Lab

  • Developing a fully functional scaled turbojet engine, guided by finite element analysis and computational fluid dynamics.
  • Worked on the Turbine, Nozzle, and Rotor subteams, running ANSYS simulations to find designs that withstand hotfire tests.
  • Pictured: FEA testing on the aerospike nozzle and a turbine rotor.

Computer Integrated Engineering and Design Senior Project

  • 3D-printed tilt-rotor drone that uses micro-servo linkage to pivot rotor modules for better thrust performance.
  • Compared propeller and airfoil types and ran CFD simulations to design a toroidal blade for 3D printing that minimizes weight and noise without sacrificing strength.

NASA Virginia Aerospace Science and Technology Scholars (VASTS)

  • Designed technical drawings for a potential lunar colony aimed at raw material extraction, and for devices that assist astronauts on EVAs during Lunar Gateway construction.
  • Earned an invitation to the NASA Hampton facility to continue research with peers after submitting reports.
  • CAD, technical drawings, lunar and ISS research.
